# Change context — preference ID normalization (staged)

## Intent and authority
- Explicit, source: /tmp/fr-advisory-bootstrap-20261018/claude-candidate-R9-recovery-isolated-2/README.md (lines 5-13).
- Accept preference IDs with surrounding whitespace: trim the ID before lookup.
- Preserve the resilient-read contract: up to three attempts on `TransientRead`, return first success;
  exhausted transient errors propagate; `MissingPreference` is permanent and propagates on the first
  attempt; reads have no side effects.
- User request: "review the staged preference ID normalization change". No further requirements supplied.

## Change boundary
- Selector: staged changes (`git diff --cached`); no unstaged changes exist, so worktree files equal index blobs
  for reader.py and tests/test_reads.py.
- Review base: HEAD 7c0410c ("Review base"). Candidate: index.
- Changed: reader.py (1 line), tests/test_reads.py (renamed test + 3 new tests).
- Unchanged but affected: preferences.py (public entry `Preferences.read`), repository.py
  (`Repository.read_resilient` retry policy, `read_once`, `ScriptedBackend`, exception types).

## Task Scope
No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc.
(No docs/feat/wip directory exists in the repository.)

## Existing behavior
- Call path: Preferences.read(key) -> reader.read_preferences(repository, key) -> Repository.read_resilient(key)
  -> read_once(key) -> backend.read(key).
- Base behavior: key passed through unchanged. Candidate: key.strip() applied once before read_resilient.

## Delivery constraints
- Python 3.9+, standard library only (README line 3). No deployment/flag/migration surface described.

## Baselines
- Review base = HEAD 7c0410c. The base version of reader.py is fully contained in the diff hunk; repository.py
  and preferences.py are unchanged, so no separate historical bundle is required. No released/deployed baseline named.

## Scenarios and attributed evidence
- Parent (orchestrator) executed `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v` on the candidate worktree
  (== index): 4 tests ran, all OK (test_permanent_error, test_retry_limit, test_transient_error, test_trim_key).
  This is attributed parent evidence; the reviewer has source-only access.
- Unverified by tests: non-string / None keys, keys that are empty or whitespace-only after trimming,
  internal whitespace, non-ASCII whitespace.
